name: Civil War: Avengers and Aftermath Reading Order
description: The Avengers path through Civil War and out the other side, compiled by hand from a reader's outline of Comic Book Herald's guide to Avengers trade collections. It pairs the seven-issue event with the New Avengers issues that run alongside it, the Young Avengers and Runaways tie-in, and Warren Ellis and Mike Deodato's Thunderbolts, which is not an Avengers title but is what makes Dark Avengers make sense later. It then follows the split into Mighty Avengers, the Initiative, Avengers/Invaders and the Illuminati.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
